story.title: Show HN: Simple algorithm and color space to generate diverse skin tones

draft:
I've been exploring a new algorithm that generates diverse skin tones using a simple color space. 
The approach is surprisingly effective, producing a wide range of realistic tones. 
This could have significant implications for AI systems that interact with humans. 
How can we apply this technology to improve inclusivity in our own projects?
#AI #InclusiveTech #SkinToneRepresentation
